You see a shovel.
It weighs 35.00 oz.

Notes

Shovels are very useful for opening holes in Loose Stone Piles or digging through sand in the desert. A necessity for most trips, but only one member of a team needs to bring one. Can usually be found littering the ground in the Kazordoon Dwarf Mines. It does the same duty as its lighter counter part, the Light Shovel. This item is no longer available from Dixi or Obi, since they became specialised dealers in weapons and armors.

Sneaky Stabber of Eliteness, Squeezing Gear of Girlpower and Whacking Driller of Fate can be used as a shovel.

One shovel can be seen in Al's Shop in Rookgaard.

Can be gotten through The Beginning Quest.
This item can be used to open 500 Loose Stone Piles in order to gain the achievement The Undertaker.
